spread.description: Whether it opens up to show how far shots can stray.

fov.description: The field of view, in degrees.

look.description: How far the view turns per pixel moved, in radians, before the player's sensitivity.

touch.description: With a finger: it travels less than a mouse.
The touch stick, under the left thumb.

reach.description: How far its knob goes, in CSS pixels.

dead.description: The share of its reach a resting thumb can move without walking.

side.description: The share of the screen's width, from the left, where a touch takes the stick.

ping.description: Whether the round trip to the host shows in the corner.

pad.description: A gamepad: how fast its right stick turns the view, and how it feels. Optional: these are the numbers without it.

look.description: How fast the view turns with the right stick right over, in radians a second, before the player's sensitivity.

dead.description: The share of a stick's travel a resting stick may drift without moving you or the view.

curve.description: How the right stick's tilt turns into turning speed: 1 straight, more for finer aim near the middle.
